findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: plaza_board_read, plaza_board_post, bsc_pool_scan · Private data: bsc_token_preflight, bsc_rug_watch, plaza_board_post, erc8183_escrow_status, bsc_pool_scan, pancakeswap_fee_tiers, pancakeswap_position_look, bobai_token_info, bobai_circulating_supply, bobai_wallet_balance, bobai_guide, bobai_tokenomics, bobai_liquidity, bobai_nft_drop, bobai_smart_money · Public sink: bsc_rug_watch, plaza_board_post, bsc_pool_scan, pancakeswap_position_look, pancakeswap_range_plan · Destructive: bsc_token_preflight, bnb_agent_census, bobai_purchase_guide, bobai_nft_drop, bobai_smart_money.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: plaza_board_read, plaza_board_post, bsc_pool_scan · Private data: bsc_token_preflight, bsc_rug_watch, plaza_board_post, erc8183_escrow_status, bsc_pool_scan, pancakeswap_fee_tiers, pancakeswap_position_look, bobai_token_info, bobai_circulating_supply, bobai_wallet_balance, bobai_guide, bobai_tokenomics, bobai_liquidity, bobai_nft_drop, bobai_smart_money · Public sink: bsc_rug_watch, plaza_board_post, bsc_pool_scan, pancakeswap_position_look, pancakeswap_range_plan · Destructive: bsc_token_preflight, bnb_agent_census, bobai_purchase_guide, bobai_nft_drop, bobai_smart_money

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
